title: Uber rival inDrive scales beyond ride-hailing to capture more consumer spending | TechCrunch
summary: Smit declined to disclose how much capital inDrive has earmarked for its newer businesses in general. The company has also brought former Google executive Max Silin to lead the ads business, called inDrive.Ads, and promoted Valentin Laykov to oversee its delivery business.
